technique_name: Write a short report about the ethics of collecting data through internet
description: The Internet has provided companies and organizations with unprecedented opportunities to collect, store, and analyze vast amounts of data to aid decision-making processes, improve customer experience, and target advertisements. As such, ethical considerations must be taken into account, as the collection and use of data can lead to privacy violations, data manipulation, and unfairly biased decisions.
